agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
September 3, 2025, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
One West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Keokia Childress,
  representing the owner, for Special Use Permit No. 25-
  00006(SUP25-00006) to allow an event center within a shopping
  center on a C-2 zoned property located at 967 North La Brea
  Avenue.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-102) has been prepared,
  stating that the proposed project is categorically exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act. A copy of this notice
  is available for public review in the Planning Division office
  of  City  Hall  and  upon  request  via  email  to
  smay@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1)Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-102; and
  adopt the attached resolution approving SUP25-00006
  2)If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  B. Take the above actions, but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 5a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Mitzie Edwards,
  representing Panini Kabob Grill, for Special Use Permit No. 25-
  00017(SUP25-00017) to allow the on-site sale of beer and wine
  in an approximately 4,988 square-foot proposed restaurant that
  is part of the Hollywood Park Tomorrow retail center on a Mixed-
  Use designated HPSP  (Hollywood Park Specific Plan) zoned
  property at 1261 South District Drive.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-101) has been prepared,
  stating that the proposed project is categorically exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act. A copy of this notice
  is available for public review in the Planning Division office
  of  City  Hall  and  upon  request  via  email  to  al-
  martell@cityofinglewood.org.
   Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1)Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-101; and
  adopt the attached resolution approving SUP25-00017
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions, but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 5b Documents

6.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Kenrick
  Sanderlin, representing the City of Inglewood, to construct a
  new approximately 600 square-foot restroom at 3400 Arbor Vitae
  Street (Darby Park).

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-105) has been prepared,
  stating that the proposed project is categorically exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act. A copy of this notice
  is available for public review in the Planning Division office
  of  City  Hall  and  upon  request  via  email  to
  smay@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2025-105;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving PCR25-00007.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of September 4, 2025,
is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda
item being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda
item will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning
Commission meeting.
  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 1, 2025, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
